profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer learning new technologies, paradigms and finding the simplest solution for complex problems.

Focused on clean and reusable code.
Interested in Functional Programming and Software Architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a caching strategy for the API improving the webpage load in 2x. The modifications included restructuring the API, split the caches in logical pieces and reassemble them for API consumption.

Extracted part of the application to an external service to centralize content and designed the interface to communicate data between both applications.

Created a scheduler to efficiently deliver surveys to patients based their surgery date.

positions.title: Rails/iOS developer
positions.description:
Cofounded this company and help setting up standards and best practices for the code base.

I developed web applications with main focus on the backend side which included features as online payment, API exposure, real time communication using web sockets and iOS applications which consumes data from APIs as well as from web sockets.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked as part time when studying at University. I started working here 6 months after I learned Ruby on Rails looking for new challenges and to keep learning by working on real life development.

Developed 3 different applications for internal data management using Ruby on Rails, MySQL and Javascript

educations.degreeName: Student Abroad for the Winter Term

honors.title: 1st. Place on Mexico DAL 2012
honors.description: Developed http://codeandomexico.org, a place to connect organizations managing Open Data with geeks interested in making a solution for their needs. The platform connects github, linkedin and twitter accounts to generate users profile and let organizations interact with anyone involved on the shown projects; the organizations can upload projects descriptions and link Open Data files through the site hosting them on CKAN.org

honors.title: 1st. Place on OpenData MX 2012
honors.description: Best application focused on Open Data and Open Government. Becalia is a crowdfunding platform where people can be helped to keep studying university. The intention is to drive in a transparent way funds for potential students and display all information about students, funds, and people helping the initiative. Funders can get tax benefits and a feed for every student helped, and students don't have the liability for managing their funds with the university.

projects.title: InvoiceIt
projects.description: CBB invoicing system for the mexican market.

projects.title: Becalia
projects.description: La red de filantropía más grande y abierta dirijida a estudiantes de nivel superior en México
